name: Lightspeed Hero (CR 1)
body:
Lightspeed Hero
CR 1

Half-elf unchained monk 1/champion 1
NG Medium humanoid (elf, human)/outsider (native)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 Wis)
hp 15 (1d10+5)
Fort +2, Ref +5, Will +4. +2 racial vs. enchantment spells and effects
Defensive Abilities hard to kill; Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 61 ft. (+1 favored class bonus [elf ], +30 impossible speed)
Melee unarmed strike +1 (1d6) or butterfly sword +1 (1d4)
Special Attacks fleet charge, flurry of blows (+1 attack), mythic power 5/day, stunning fist 6/day (DC 12), surge +1d6

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 16, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 14
Base Atk +1, CMB +1, CMD 16
Traits Charming, Enlightened Warrior
Feats Dodge, Planar Heritage (aasimar), Improved Unarmed Strike, Stunning FistM
Skills Acrobatics +7/+19, Diplomacy +3/+4, Escape Artist +7, Sense Motive +6
Languages Common, Elven
SQ dual minded
Gear butterfly sword (20 gp), handwraps (1 sp), monk’s kit (8 gp), monk’s outfit (5 gp), 1 gp, 9 sp
